S4.title: Under the hood: scopes, aliasing, mutability

S1.python-intro: What Python is: interpreted, high-level, multi-paradigm, garbage collected, history, IDEs, notebooks, pip
S1.syntax-basics: Indentation and code blocks, colon, comments, docstrings, line continuation, pass, statements vs expressions
S1.types: Elementary types (None, bool, int, float, complex, str), type(), infinite-precision ints, float precision
S1.variables: Binding names to values, rebinding, dynamic typing, duck typing, multiple assignment
S1.operators: Arithmetic (/, //, %, **, divmod, pow), precedence, type promotion, str*int, str+int
S1.logic-comparisons: Comparisons, chained comparisons, ==/!= vs is, and/or/not short-circuit and return values, truthiness
S1.strings: Quotes, escapes, indexing, negative indices, slicing, immutability, methods (upper, split, join, strip, replace, count, find...), f-strings, min/max/len on strings
S1.conditionals: if/elif/else evaluation order, ternary operator, one-line forms, nested ifs
S1.loops: while and for loops, range(start, stop, step), iterating strings/lists, infinite loops, loop equivalence
S1.imports-main: import, from ... import, aliases, module prefix, if __name__ == '__main__'
S1.functions-basics: def, parameters, return value, implicit None return, print vs return, rebinding function names, built-ins (len, id, type, print, int, float, bool)

S2.function-arguments: Positional vs keyword arguments, default values, parameter order rules, functions as arguments
S2.program-flow: Execution flow vs text flow, call stack (LIFO), mutually recursive calls
S2.lists: List creation, indexing, mutability, append/extend/insert/pop/remove/index/count, len, +, *, in, nested lists
S2.slicing: start:stop:step, defaults, negative steps, slice assignment, copies via slicing, out-of-range slices
S2.tuples: Tuple syntax, single-element tuples, immutability, packing/unpacking, swap, returning multiple values, concatenation
S2.dicts: Keys/values/items, lookup, KeyError, get, in tests keys, update, deletion, hashable keys, iteration order, dict()
S2.sets: Set literals, set() vs {}, uniqueness, union/intersection/difference/subset, add/remove/discard, membership
S2.comprehensions: List/dict/set comprehensions, conditions, nested comprehensions, generator expressions
S2.conversions: int()/float()/str()/list()/tuple()/set() conversions, int(s, base), ord/chr, str() of containers, bool()
S2.args-kwargs: *args and **kwargs, unpacking with * and ** at call site, keyword-only parameters
S2.stdlib-pip: Standard library modules, pip install, requirements.txt, PyPI, third-party packages

S3.filesystem-paths: Absolute vs relative paths, ., .., current working directory, os.getcwd/chdir, os.path, glob
S3.shell-env: Shell commands (ls, cd, pwd, mkdir, rm, cat, grep), environment variables, PATH, os.environ
S3.files-io: open() modes (r, w, a, b, +), with, reading (read, readline, readlines, iteration), writing, closing, encoding
S3.serialization: pickle (binary, dump/load), json (dump/dumps/load/loads), what can be serialized
S3.modules-packages: Modules and packages, __init__.py, import forms, __name__, project layout
S3.exceptions: try/except/else/finally, raise, exception hierarchy, catching specific vs Exception, custom exceptions, common built-in exceptions
S3.time-dates: time.time, time.sleep, datetime.now, timedelta, date arithmetic

S4.interpreter-execution: How CPython runs a script line by line, what def/import do, hardware basics (CPU/RAM/disk), running python (-m, -c)
S4.scopes: Local/enclosing/global/builtin (LEGB), global and nonlocal, shadowing, UnboundLocalError, no block scope
S4.identity-equality: id(), is vs ==, object identity, small int/str caching caveats, None comparisons
S4.aliasing: Several names bound to the same object, mutation visible through aliases, aliasing in function calls
S4.mutability: Mutable vs immutable types, in-place vs rebinding, += on lists vs tuples/strings, mutable default arguments
S4.copying: copy.copy vs copy.deepcopy, slicing/list() copies, [x]*n sharing trap
S4.first-class-functions: Functions as values, returning functions, closures, lambda, higher-order functions
S4.recursion: Recursive functions, base cases, call stack, RecursionError, recursion vs iteration
S4.keywords: Reserved keywords vs built-in names, shadowing built-ins

S5.classes-objects: class, instances, __init__ as initializer, self, instance attributes, dynamic attributes, AttributeError
S5.methods: Instance methods, b.f(x) == Class.f(b, x), forgetting self, calling methods, methods vs functions
S5.inheritance: Subclasses, overriding, super(), isinstance/issubclass, object base class, multiple inheritance and MRO
S5.class-instance-attributes: Class variables vs instance variables, shadowing a class attribute through an instance
S5.oop-concepts: 4 pillars (abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism), classes as blueprints, built-in types are classes
S5.gui-mvc: MVC pattern, 3-tier architecture, Tkinter widgets, callbacks (function, lambda, closure, callable object), mainloop
S5.args-kwargs-advanced: Variable number of arguments, *args/**kwargs collection and unpacking, keyword-only arguments after *args

S6.numpy-arrays: np.array, dtype, shape, ndim, size, reshape (incl. -1), arange, linspace, zeros/ones
S6.numpy-axes: Axis semantics for sum/max/mean etc., aggregations over axis=0/1/None
S6.numpy-indexing: Multi-axis indexing a[i, j], slicing rows/columns, views vs copies, fancy indexing
S6.numpy-broadcasting: Broadcasting rules, compatible/incompatible shapes, scalar broadcasting
S6.numpy-masking: Boolean masks, filtering, element-wise comparison, &, |, ~ vs and/or
S6.numpy-operations: Element-wise ops vs Python lists, transpose, hstack/vstack/concatenate, sort, dot, vectorization, structured arrays
S6.pandas-basics: Series and DataFrame creation, index, columns, head/tail/shape/info, read_csv(index_col)
S6.pandas-selection: df['col'] (Series) vs df[['col']] (DataFrame), loc vs iloc, label slicing inclusive, boolean filtering, isin
S6.pandas-cleaning: isnull, dropna (axis), fillna, drop_duplicates, rename, inplace semantics
S6.pandas-analysis: describe, value_counts, mean, apply, groupby, vectorized column operations
S6.visualization: Matplotlib figures/axes, plt.subplots, plt.show, legend, pandas .plot(kind=...), Seaborn plots

S7.generators: Generator expressions vs list comprehensions, yield, lazy evaluation, exhaustion, memory
S7.iterators: Iterables vs iterators, iter/next, __iter__/__next__, StopIteration, for-loop protocol
S7.functional: lambda, map, filter, sorted/sort with key, any/all, zip, reduce, itertools/functools
S7.assertions: assert statement, AssertionError, assertion messages, disabling with -O
S7.testing: unittest TestCase, assert methods, test discovery, unittest.main, coverage
S7.logging-debugging: logging levels, default WARNING level, basicConfig, logging vs print, debuggers and breakpoints
S7.argparse: Command-line arguments, ArgumentParser, add_argument types and defaults, parse_args
S7.efficiency: Built-ins, vectorization with NumPy/Pandas, avoiding loops, complexity intuition, multiprocessing, Numba/Cython
S7.good-practices: Zen of Python, PEP 8, docstrings, type hints, project structure, __init__.py, README/requirements.txt, version control, code review

S8.web-architecture: Clients and servers, internet/ISP, IP addresses, DNS resolution, ports, TCP connections, packets
S8.http: HTTP request/response, methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), status codes, headers, rendering, AJAX
S8.urls: URL anatomy: scheme, user info, host, port, path, query, fragment, default ports, escaping
S8.requests-lib: requests.get/post, status_code, text vs content, .json(), wget/curl
S8.flask: Flask(__name__), @app.route decorators, route variables, return values, render_template, app.run(port), localhost/127.0.0.1
S8.web-serialization: JSON and pickle for exchanging data, json.dumps/loads, API servers
